dir.profile: Viktor Andreevich — a polite, formal Russian school headmaster in his 50s in a suit, a bit pompous, official tone.
dir.notes: Line 1: formal, a bit embarrassed, slow; the last word «ведро» said with hurt pride. Line 2: formal, touched, official tone, small pause after «Анатолий». Line 3: warm, happy, relaxed, at home, inviting a friend.
